# GitHub Copilot Instructions

See **[`AGENTS.md`](../AGENTS.md)** at the repository root. It is the canonical, tool-neutral
instruction file for all AI-assisted work in this repo — repository structure, the
read-before-implementing list, the development workflow (`Roadmap → MVP → Plan →
Implementation → Test → Pull Request`), the coding / testing / git / documentation
standards, the AI action rules, and the secrets rules.

GitHub Copilot's coding agent reads `AGENTS.md` natively. This file adds nothing beyond that
pointer — do not put standalone rules here.
